source: client brief — High Heat Identification Solutions

tagline.en: Engineered for high heat. Built for reliable identification.
tagline.zh: 耐受严苛高温，保障稳定识别。

positioning.en: Built with high-performance materials, specialty adhesives, and durable topcoats, our high heat identification solutions are engineered for demanding thermal processes. They maintain reliable adhesion, clear identification, and long-lasting durability across a wide range of high-temperature manufacturing applications.
positioning.zh: 采用高性能面材、特种胶粘技术及耐高温涂层，专为严苛高温工艺打造，在高温、热循环及复杂制造环境中保持稳定粘接、清晰识别和持久耐用，满足各类高温制造应用的标识需求。

heading.zh: 为什么选择耐高温标签？

intro.en: High-temperature applications require more than heat-resistant materials. The right combination of facestock, adhesive, and protective coating ensures labels remain securely bonded and readable throughout demanding thermal processes.
intro.zh: 高温应用不仅需要耐热材料，更需要面材、胶粘剂和保护涂层的协同设计，才能在严苛高温工艺中保持牢固粘接、清晰识别和稳定性能。

en: High-performance materials for demanding thermal environments
Specialty adhesives for reliable bonding at elevated temperatures
Durable topcoats resistant to heat, abrasion, and chemicals
Engineered for a wide range of industrial applications
zh: 高性能材料，适用于严苛高温环境
特种胶粘技术，实现高温下稳定粘接
耐高温、耐磨损、耐化学腐蚀保护涂层
条码及打印信息长期清晰可读
满足多种高温制造工艺应用需求

en.title: Steam Sterilization
en.desc: Labels withstand repeated steam sterilization cycles while remaining securely bonded and fully readable.
en.apps: Medical devices • Surgical instruments • Laboratory containers • Healthcare equipment

en.title: Paint & Powder Coating
en.desc: Labels remain bonded and readable throughout paint and powder coating bake cycles without bubbling, discoloration, or print degradation.
en.apps: Automotive parts • Metal fabrication • Appliances • Industrial equipment

en.title: Rubber Vulcanization
en.desc: Labels applied before curing withstand heat, pressure, and rubber expansion throughout the vulcanization process.
en.apps: Tires • Rubber hoses • Rubber seals • Molded rubber components

en.title: PCB Reflow Soldering
en.desc: Designed for multiple lead-free reflow cycles while maintaining reliable adhesion, barcode readability, and PCB traceability. At this range, coated polyimide (PI) film is the industry-standard facestock.
en.apps: PCB manufacturing • SMT assembly • Electronic components • PCBA traceability

en.title: Ultra High Temperature Direct Apply
en.desc: Labels are applied directly onto hot steel, aluminum, or other metal surfaces immediately after casting or rolling, eliminating the need for cooling before identification.
en.apps: Steel mills • Aluminum processing • Copper processing • Continuous casting • Hot rolling

en.title: Heat Treatment Process Management
en.desc: Labels are applied before heat treatment and remain with the product throughout annealing, firing, sintering, and other thermal processes to ensure continuous identification.
en.apps: Steel • Ceramics • Porcelain • Concrete • Electronics • Metal fabrication

zh.title: 高温蒸汽灭菌
zh.desc: 标签可耐受反复高温高压蒸汽灭菌，在灭菌过程中保持牢固粘贴和清晰识别。
zh.apps: 医疗器械 • 手术器械 • 实验室容器 • 医疗设备

zh.title: 喷涂与粉末涂装固化
zh.desc: 标签在喷漆和粉末涂装烘烤过程中保持牢固粘贴，不起泡、不变色，打印信息清晰可读。
zh.apps: 汽车零部件 • 金属制品 • 家电制造 • 工业设备

zh.title: 橡胶硫化
zh.desc: 标签在硫化过程中耐受高温、高压及橡胶膨胀，保持稳定识别。
zh.apps: 轮胎 • 橡胶软管 • 密封件 • 橡胶制品

zh.title: PCB 回流焊
zh.desc: 适用于多次无铅回流焊工艺，保持稳定粘接、条码清晰及产品追溯。在该温区，涂布型聚酰亚胺（PI）薄膜是行业标准面材。
zh.apps: PCB 制造 • SMT 贴装 • 电子元器件 • PCBA 追溯

zh.title: 超高温直贴
zh.desc: 标签可直接贴附于高温钢材、铝材等赤热金属表面，无需等待冷却即可完成产品标识。
zh.apps: 钢铁制造 • 铝加工 • 铜加工 • 连铸 • 热轧

zh.title: 热处理过程管理
zh.desc: 标签于常温贴附，随产品经历退火、淬火、烧结等高温工艺，在整个热处理过程中保持稳定识别。
zh.apps: 钢铁 • 陶瓷 • 瓷制品 • 混凝土制品 • 电子制造 • 金属加工
